jess (Support): heads up — Acme (ticket #5672) reporting structured output failures after last night's model rollout (v4.1-prod). Their downstream JSON parser is failing. Example attached. @raj @oliver

raj (ML Eng): copy. can you paste the raw response + request_id? sounds like changed quoting/array wrapping.

jess (Support): here's the curl we used and the raw payload/response we got from the API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v4","input":"List products as json array","json_mode":true}'
```
Raw response (what the customer received):
```json
{
  "request_id": "RQ-20260304-89abc",
  "output": "[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"Widget A\"},{\"id\":2,\"name\":\"Widget B\"}]",
  "warnings": []
}
```
They expect output to be an actual array (not a string) — their parser does JSON.parse(output) and it fails now. Previously the API returned output as an array.

oliver (Infra): do we have request_id + timestamp? I can look at routing and config.

jess (Support): request_id above and approximate time 2026-03-04T03:15:34Z. customer attached their client error log: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token \" in JSON at position 0` when parsing output.

raj (ML Eng): this smells like the new serializer flags we toggled in v4.1 — we flipped a stringification option to preserve escaping for some SDKs. Did we accidentally enable stringify on arrays? @oliver any config merges in the serving runtime?

oliver (Infra): yes — there was a config patch applied at ~03:12 UTC that set `serialization.stringify_arrays: true` in model runtime config to deal with legacy SDK behavior. I thought it was safe. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: rollback config patch cfg-442 by oliver at 1784501300

jess (Support): customer impact is high; several endpoints affected. I've recommended temporary mitigation: pin to redwood-v3.9 or have them set `response_format=raw` client-side if available. They're asking for ETA on a fix.

raj (ML Eng): thanks. We'll revert the stringify_arrays change and add a test to ensure top-level arrays remain native when `json_mode=true`. ETA 30m for rollback + verification.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: cfg-442 reverted at 1784501360

oliver (Infra): monitoring logs now. noticed a small spike in 502s during the rollback window, investigating whether the config switch caused transient routing errors.

jess (Support): Acme just confirmed they re-ran and parser now succeeds. They said: "Looks good on our side — thanks for quick turnaround." Closing ticket pending any further reports :thumbsup:

raj (ML Eng): follow-ups: 1) add unit test for serialization for top-level arrays 2) add a canary to prevent config with stringify_arrays=true from shipping without explicit compatibility flag 3) notify SDK teams of config behavior.

oliver (Infra): opened infra ticket INF-789 to track rollback impact and to add alerting.

jess (Support): marking ticket #5672 resolved. If Acme sees regressions we'll reopen. Thanks everyone.
